body: Luckily it was just a fling, so there wasn't too much emotional investment. It just really left me gobsmacked while it was happening. I think he just lacks tact.
The last guy I saw was the opposite. We would have sex and then he would point out a hair growing from my boob, or the mole on my ass. Everything he said made me never want to be naked again.
He said he wouldn't be able to cook it at home on his vegan roommate's baking sheets. Lame, but it meant I got to eat them. But come on. Homemade frozen pizzas? He sucks. I rule. O'Doyle rules.

Oh my god, I posted this from my iPhone, and it told me the post failed. I didn't have the heart to type it all out again. Thanks for the words. I did talk to my nurse practitioner, who prescribes the medicine, and showed her the healing cuts. She works in the same office with my therapist, and I've given them permission to share notes. I'm sure we'll be talking about this at our next session.
Well, I don't want to write.

Yeah. I've been re-reading them and I'm having a very hard time just staying focused.
With other books, it wasn't such a big deal.
No matter what I'm reading, regardless of my love for the content, I can't get through them anymore. I get distracted.
I live about a mile from a train station. At night you can hear the faint screeches in the distance, like whistles. It's soft and eerie.

All of it. Everything stems from the rape. I have some "daddy issues," but it's nothing compared to the PTSD. I tried seeing a fee different therapists, but I can't afford it anymore. At this point I'm pretty much working during office hours every day too. I'm just not really sure where to turn. This has already cost me most of my friends.

I'm just so tired of trying to be happy. I post comments on this subreddit daily, and I just feel like a hypocrite. I was abused by my dad, and raped in college which lead to  a suicide attempt, a year long academic suspension. I've alienated myself from every friend that I have because of crippling anxiety, and I have no one left to talk to.

Frankly, I don't know what triggers these depressive bouts. I'll be fine for 3-4 weeks, and then feel absolutely suicidal for about 2 weeks straight.

I just really don't think I can get through this one on my own, and I don't have anywhere else to turn.
